verdict.rationale: Netlify documents serverless functions for building APIs (netlify-docs-6), and community users confirm zero-config Lambda functions (netlify-comm-8), so code execution is evidenced. Edge execution near users is only implied, via a Turso integration listing that refers to 'your edge functions' and deploying globally (netlify-intdir-5). Missing for 10: first-party docs for an edge functions runtime, evidence of a global edge network or PoP footprint, latency/locality details, and independent hands-on corroboration of edge execution.
